reason: A browser-side DSH UI plugin that adds a color-coded DeepSeek API peak or off-peak pricing indicator beside the model selector, shown only for supported DeepSeek sessions and refreshed periodically.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 对话框模型选择按钮旁显示 DeepSeek API 当前峰价或谷价状态的浏览器端界面插件。
summaries.en: A browser-side DSH UI plugin that displays the current DeepSeek API peak or off-peak pricing status beside the model selector.

capabilities: Reads current session model information to determine whether the active model is a DeepSeek model
Reads provider configuration to distinguish supported official sources
Displays a peak or off-peak pricing status indicator in the conversation input area
Refreshes the displayed status every 30 seconds based on Asia/Shanghai time
